criteria.requirement: Add sqlparse.sourcemap.SourceMap and immutable SourceSpan for opt-in original character offsets [start,end), one-based start/end line/column. Bind the actual candidate parse statements and all atomic/group tokens without changing default Token slots. Preserve every original character including whitespace/comments/CRLF, Unicode combining codepoints and multiple statement offsets; decoded bytes use explicit encoding and coordinates refer to decoded characters, not UTF-8 bytes or display graphemes. Exact source slicing must equal token/group text. Foreign tokens reject; any leaf value/type/identity/order mutation invalidates later lookups rather than silently reporting stale positions. Empty input is supported, and this tool never executes SQL.

Investigate the real source, explain the call path and clarify the business requirements before obtaining plan approval and implementing. Deliver real engineering changes, public regression tests that fail on the original version, and English compatibility documentation. Repair independently reported failures; questions, answers and documentation do not count as separate completed objectives.

comparison: Accept equivalent implementations according to actual business behavior and the frozen scope; do not grade by matching the reference patch text.
